examples.en: If you pass the national exam, you get a license.
To become a nurse, you have to take a national exam.
I practically live in the library preparing for the national exam.
On the day of the national exam, I was nervous from the morning.
When the national exam is over, I'm going on a trip.
The national exam results come out next week.

explain: 의사, 간호사, 변호사처럼 나라에서 자격을 주는 시험을 말해요. 보통 '국가시험을 보다/치르다', '국가시험에 합격하다'로 써요.

phrases.en: I'm preparing for next year's state exam.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시험 공부를 하는 중일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you are studying for the exam.
phrases.en_equiv: to prepare for the state exam

phrases.en: I passed the state exam, so I'm really happy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시험 결과가 좋을 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the exam result is good.

phrases.en: I failed the state exam, so I'm studying again.
phrases.nuance_ko: 합격하지 못했을 때 쓰는 일상적인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An everyday way to say you did not pass.

explain_en: It refers to exams that grant a state-recognized qualification, as for doctors, nurses or lawyers. It is typically used as '국가시험을 보다/치르다' or '국가시험에 합격하다'.

examples.en: Let's wrap up today's work here.
I closed the presentation with a greeting.
I'll finish the report by tomorrow.
I want to end it on a good note.
What's a good way to wrap up this year?
I rushed to finish and made a mistake.

explain: '마무리하다'는 일의 끝 부분을 잘 정리해 끝낼 때 써요. 그냥 '끝내다'보다 마지막 손질을 한다는 느낌이 있어요. '일을 마무리하다', '마무리 짓다'처럼 말해요.

phrases.en: Let's wrap up today's meeting here.
phrases.nuance_ko: '마무리하다'와 뜻이 같고, 끝을 낸다는 느낌이 조금 더 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning, with a slightly stronger sense of bringing it to an end.

phrases.en: The construction will be finished next week.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일이 저절로 끝나는 쪽을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the work comes to an end by itself.

phrases.en: I'll finish my work and go home.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일을 끝낸 다음 다른 일을 이어 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Links finishing something to the next action.

explain_en: 마무리하다 means tidying up and ending the last part of a task well. Compared with plain 끝내다, it gives the feel of putting on finishing touches. You say '일을 마무리하다' or '마무리 짓다'.

dis.h: wrap up a task with final touches

p.n: 종료하다 formally declares an end; 마무리하다 means wrapping up and finishing off.

examples.ko: 머리가 아파서 양호실에 가서 누워 있었어요.
examples.en: My head hurt, so I went to the nurse's office and lay down.
The nurse's office teacher got medicine for me.
I fell during gym class and went to the nurse's office.

examples.ko: 양호실에는 침대 두 개가 놓여 있어요.
examples.en: There are two beds in the nurse's office.

examples.ko: 열이 나면 먼저 양호실에 가 보세요.
examples.en: If you have a fever, go to the nurse's office first.
After resting a little in the nurse's office, I felt better.

explain: 학교에서 아픈 학생을 돌보는 방이에요. 요즘 학교에서는 '보건실'이라고 많이 불러요. 같은 장소를 가리키는 말이라서 어른들은 옛날 말인 '양호실'을 쓰기도 해요.

phrases.en: My stomach hurt, so I went to the nurse's office.
phrases.nuance_ko: 요즘 학교에서 더 많이 쓰는 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The name more commonly used in schools these days.

phrases.en: I had a fever, so I rested in the infirmary.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아플 때 잠깐 누워 있을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when lying down for a while because you feel sick.

phrases.en: The school nurse put a bandage on me.
phrases.nuance_ko: 양호실에서 학생을 돌봐 주는 선생님을 부르는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The way to refer to the teacher who looks after students in the infirmary.

explain_en: It is the room at school where sick students are looked after. Schools today often call it '보건실'. It refers to the same place, and adults sometimes still use the older word '양호실'.

examples.ko: 이 에세이는 여행 이야기를 담고 있어요.
examples.en: This essay is full of travel stories.
I write a short essay every weekend.

examples.ko: 친구가 추천한 에세이 책을 읽고 있어요.
examples.en: I am reading an essay book my friend recommended.

examples.ko: 그 작가는 소설보다 에세이로 더 유명해요.
examples.en: That author is better known for essays than for novels.
You can feel the author's honest thoughts in the essay.
The newly released essay collection is popular at bookstores.

explain: 소설과 달리 지은이의 경험과 생각을 쓴 글을 가리켜요. 서점에서는 '소설', '시', '에세이'처럼 갈래 이름으로도 봐요. 같은 뜻의 한자어로 '수필'도 있어요.

phrases.en: That author wrote many essays.
phrases.nuance_ko: '에세이'와 같은 뜻의 한자어예요. 책이나 글을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A Sino-Korean word meaning the same as '에세이', common for books and writing.

phrases.en: I read essays before going to bed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 글을 읽을 때 쓰는 가장 흔한 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing for reading this kind of writing.

phrases.example: 제 꿈은 에세이 작가가 되는 거예요.
phrases.en: My dream is to become an essay writer.
phrases.nuance_ko: 에세이를 쓰는 사람을 말할 때 '작가'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add '작가' to refer to a person who writes essays.

explain_en: Unlike a novel, it is writing based on the author's own experiences and thoughts. Bookstores use it as a genre label next to novels and poems. A Sino-Korean word with the same sense, 수필, also exists.

examples.en: My younger sister became a middle school girl this year.

examples.ko: 버스에서 여중생 두 명이 웃고 있었어요.
examples.en: Two middle school girls were laughing on the bus.
That middle school girl is very good at running.
The middle school girls lined up in their uniforms.
My teacher does the work of teaching middle school girls.

examples.ko: 여중생에게 인기 있는 책을 추천해 주세요.
examples.en: Please recommend a book that is popular with middle school girls.

explain: '여자 중학생'을 줄인 말이에요. '여-'는 여자라는 뜻이라서 '여고생', '여대생'도 같은 방식이에요. 남자는 '남중생'이라고도 하고, 성별을 따지지 않으면 '중학생'이라고 해요.

phrases.example: 저기 있는 여자 중학생이 제 동생이에요.
phrases.en: That middle school girl over there is my younger sibling.
phrases.nuance_ko: 줄이지 않은 원래 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The full, unshortened form.

phrases.en: The middle school girls are laughing in front of the school gate.
phrases.nuance_ko: '들'을 붙여 여러 명을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add '들' to talk about more than one.

phrases.example: 교실에 여중생 한 명이 남아 있어요.
phrases.en: One middle school girl is still in the classroom.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사람은 '명'으로 세요.
phrases.nuance_en: People are counted with '명'.

explain_en: It is a shortened form of '여자 중학생'. The '여-' means female, so '여고생' and '여대생' work the same way. For boys people also say '남중생', and if gender does not matter, '중학생'.

examples.en: I study English literature at university.
We read Shakespeare in English literature class.
My older sister graduated from the English literature department and became a translator.
I borrowed a book about English literature from the library.
English literature is fun too, but I like Korean literature more.

examples.ko: 영문학이 어렵다는 친구도 있고 쉽다는 친구도 있어요.
examples.en: Some friends say English literature is hard and others say it is easy.

explain: 대학교 전공 이름으로 써요. 나라 이름을 줄여 '문학'을 붙이는 방식은 '국문학'(한국 문학), '불문학'(프랑스 문학)에도 보여요. 전공 학과는 '영문학과'라고 해요.

phrases.en: My younger sibling is in the English literature department.
phrases.nuance_ko: '영문학'은 공부하는 분야이고 '영문학과'는 대학교의 학과 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: 영문학 is the field; 영문학과 is the university department.

phrases.en: I majored in English literature.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대학교에서 무엇을 공부했는지 말할 때 '전공하다'와 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Pairs with 전공하다 to say what you majored in.

phrases.en: Today's English literature class was fun.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대학교에서 듣는 수업을 말할 때 '수업'을 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 수업 refers to a class in the subject.

explain_en: It is used as a university major. Abbreviating the country name and adding '문학' also appears in '국문학' (Korean literature) and '불문학' (French literature). The department is '영문학과'.

examples.en: Our school holds a field day in autumn.
The field day was postponed because of rain.
I came first in the race at the field day.
On field day we bring gimbap.
The parents also took part in their child's field day.
I like May, when we have field day and go on picnics.

explain: 학교에서 달리기, 줄다리기 같은 경기를 하는 행사예요. 청군과 백군으로 팀을 나누기도 해요. 대학교나 회사의 큰 행사는 '체육대회'라고 하기도 해요.

phrases.example: 가을 운동회에서 우리 반이 줄다리기를 이겼어요.
phrases.en: Our class won the tug of war at the fall field day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한국 학교에서는 보통 가을이나 봄에 운동회를 해요. 계절을 앞에 붙여 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Korean schools usually hold field days in fall or spring; the season goes in front.

phrases.en: On field day, we bring a packed lunch.
phrases.nuance_ko: 운동회를 하는 바로 그날을 말해요. 날씨 이야기를 할 때도 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The very day the field day takes place; often used when talking about the weather.

phrases.en: My company is holding an athletic meet next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 운동회와 비슷하지만 대학교나 회사의 큰 행사에 더 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar to 운동회, but used more for big events at universities or companies.

explain_en: It is a school event with games like races and tug-of-war, sometimes split into blue and white teams. A large event at a university or company may be called '체육대회'.

en: student preparing for an entrance exam

examples.en: Exam-prep students go to cram school even during vacation.
Last year I was an entrance-exam student.

examples.ko: 입시생 자녀를 둔 부모님은 걱정이 많아요.
examples.en: Parents with a child preparing for entrance exams worry a lot.
The library is full of students preparing for exams.

examples.ko: 입시생에게는 마지막 한 달이 가장 중요해요.
examples.en: For exam-prep students the final month is the most important.

examples.ko: 입시생을 위한 간식 세트를 팔고 있어요.
examples.en: They're selling snack sets for students preparing for exams.

explain: 대학 입시를 준비하는 학생을 말해요. '수험생'은 입시뿐 아니라 자격시험 등 다른 시험을 준비하는 사람까지 넓게 가리켜요. 입시를 한 번 더 준비하는 사람은 '재수생'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I'm an exam-prep student now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 자신이 입시를 준비하는 중이라고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say you're preparing for the entrance exam.

phrases.en: I bought a cheering gift for the exam takers.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시험 준비하는 사람을 더 넓게 가리켜요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers more broadly to anyone preparing for exams.

phrases.en: My older brother is retaking the entrance exam this year.
phrases.nuance_ko: 입시를 한 번 더 준비하는 사람이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Someone preparing for the exam one more time.

explain_en: It refers to a student preparing for university entrance exams. '수험생' is broader and includes people preparing for any exam, such as certifications. Someone retaking the entrance exam is called a '재수생'.

examples.ko: 서점에서 수학 참고서를 한 권 샀어요.
examples.en: I bought a math reference book at the bookstore.
I marked the parts I did not understand in the study guide.
I inherited the study guide my older brother used.
This study guide is good because the explanations are easy.
Please use the textbook and the study guide together.
I have so many study guides that my bag is heavy.

explain: 학교에서 쓰는 '교과서'를 보충해 주는 공부 책이에요. 문제를 많이 푸는 책은 보통 '문제집'이라고 따로 불러요.

phrases.en: I bought an English study guide and study with it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 과목 이름을 앞에 붙여 어떤 참고서인지 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a subject name first to say which study guide.

phrases.en: For problems I don't know, I check the study guide and solve them.
phrases.nuance_ko: 모르는 것을 찾아볼 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when looking things up.
phrases.en_equiv: to look at a study guide

phrases.example: 참고서 말고 문제집도 한 권 샀어요.
phrases.en: Besides the study guide, I also bought a workbook.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문제를 많이 풀어 보는 책이라 참고서와 달라요.
phrases.nuance_en: A book of practice problems, different from a study guide.

explain_en: It is a study book that supplements the school '교과서' (textbook). A book mainly full of practice problems is usually called a '문제집' instead.

examples.en: I am studying Korean studies at university.
The Korean studies class is really fun.

examples.ko: 한국학은 역사와 문화를 함께 배우는 학문이에요.
examples.en: Korean studies is a field where you learn history and culture together.

examples.ko: 한국학에 관심이 많은 외국 학생이 늘었어요.
examples.en: There are more foreign students interested in Korean studies.

examples.ko: 한국학도 이제 전 세계에서 배울 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can now study Korean studies all over the world.
Our university has newly opened a Korean studies department.

explain: '-학'은 학문 이름에 붙어요. 한국학, 중국학, 일본학처럼 한 나라를 연구하는 학문에 써요. 한국어 자체를 연구하는 분야는 '한국어학'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I want to enter the Korean studies department.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대학교에서 한국학을 가르치는 학과 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The name of a university department that teaches Korean studies.

phrases.en: I majored in Korean studies.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대학교에서 주로 공부한 분야를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say what you mainly studied at university.

phrases.en: I read a book written by a Korean studies scholar.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-자'를 붙여 한국학을 연구하는 사람을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '-자' makes it a person who studies Korean studies.

explain_en: The ending '-학' marks a field of study, as in 한국학, 중국학, and 일본학. The study of the Korean language itself is called '한국어학'.
